mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, name AS name, nickname AS nickname, age AS age, grade AS grade, gender AS gender, email AS email, disease AS disease, disability AS disability, medication AS medication, total_count AS totalCount, total_distance AS totalDistance, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email = #{email}, nickname = #{nickname}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
